integrity: All-size theorem follows from explicit characteristic-polynomial and Jordan-chain proofs; finite direct checks are corroboration only. No independent audit or certification is claimed.
limitations: Finite synchronous labelled rings with exactly one exceptional site; no enumeration of primitive period lengths or multi-defect robustness. A plausible 2001 boundary-conditions source could not be inspected in full.
title: One-site Rule 150 defects and a dyadic first-entry law on Rule 90 rings
